what: Split compare: a divider whips from BEFORE to AFTER under a headline band, springs to the middle, holds alive and ends on AFTER
title: Same frame, two decisions
intent: Show a change by letting the viewer see both states at once
action: BEFORE strokes boil on slate; a divider whips across with heavy blur to reveal AFTER (a calm grid with one accent point), springs back to the middle and settles; labels pop in; a wave, a light beam and a pulse keep the hold alive; AFTER takes the frame to end
look: Duotone: slate and paper, ink, one emerald accent (style atlas #19 and #23)
make_it_yours: Replace `drawBefore()` and `drawAfter()` with your two states. Set the headline (`--title`) and `LABELS`.
craft_note: The headline sits on its own band, so it reads over both halves and the divider never crosses it. The whip uses a 360° shutter for a fuller smear. The piece ends on AFTER: finish on the answer.
